comment: This is the mirror of multiSwitcher: the same TRG/CV, DIR, xFD and RST controls, with the selector counting outputs instead of inputs. The DIR switch is configured Down, Random, Up from the bottom position up. Props are recorded for the first left and first right output only, because the other seven pairs are written by the same code path. The IN and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
